title: Cardamonin Inhibits the Nuclear Translocation and DNA Binding of RelA in the Tumor Necrosis Factor-alpha-Induced NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway in Human Lung Adenocarcinoma A549 Cells.
authors: Vu, Nhat Thi; Vu, Quy Van; Vo, Nghia Trong; Tanigaki, Riho; Quach, Hue Tu; Miyake, Yasunobu; Shiba, Tomoo; Kataoka, Takao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究豆蔻明抑制RelA核转位及DNA结合以阻断NF-kB信号通路，含分子对接分析RelA互作位点，属蛋白-DNA互作机制研究但非TF-DNA特异性结合建模，方法以实验为主、对接为辅，故评6分。
abstract: Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha) activates the nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway, which promotes the expression of NF-kappaB-responsive genes, including intercellular adhesion molecule 1 (ICAM-1). We previously reported that cardamonin, a chalcone-type flavonoid, inhibited TNF-alpha-induced ICAM-1 expression in human lung adenocarcinoma A549 cells. However, the mechanisms by which cardamonin inhibits the TNF-alpha-induced NF-kappaB signaling pathway have yet to be elucidated. Therefore, we herein investigated the effects of cardamonin on TNF-alpha-induced gene expression and the NF-kappaB-dependent signaling pathway. Cardamonin reduced TNF-alpha-induced ICAM-1 mRNA expression and NF-kappaB reporter activity. It did not affect the inhibitor of NF-kappaB alpha (IkappaBalpha) degradation, but prevented RelA nuclear translocation and binding to the ICAM-1 promoter. Consistent with this result, three other chalcone derivatives (4'-hydroxychalcone, isoliquiritigenin, and xanthohumol) did not affect the degradation of IkappaBalpha, but inhibited nuclear RelA translocation. Cardamonin exhibited the same inhibitory profiles in human breast cancer MCF-7 cells and human fibrosarcoma HT-1080 cells. Cysteine 38 (C38) of RelA was not a primary target site of cardamonin because cardamonin inhibited the nuclear translocation of the RelA C38S mutant. An in silico molecular docking analysis confirmed that cardamonin was not positioned close enough to RelA C38 to mediate covalent binding, and also that cardamonin interacted with RelA at different sites. Mutations in these interaction sites abrogated the nuclear translocation of RelA in response to a TNF-alpha stimulation. The present results demonstrate that cardamonin inhibited the nuclear translocation of RelA and its DNA binding in the NF-kappaB signaling pathway in response to a TNF-alpha stimulation.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）激活核因子κB（NF-kappaB）信号通路，该通路促进NF-kappaB响应基因的表达，包括细胞间黏附分子1（ICAM-1）。我们此前报道过，豆蔻明（cardamonin），一种查尔酮类黄酮，抑制了人肺腺癌A549细胞中TNF-alpha诱导的ICAM-1表达。然而，豆蔻明抑制TNF-alpha诱导的NF-kappaB信号通路的机制尚未阐明。因此，本研究探讨了豆蔻明对TNF-alpha诱导的基因表达及NF-kappaB依赖性信号通路的影响。豆蔻明降低了TNF-alpha诱导的ICAM-1 mRNA表达和NF-kappaB报告基因活性。它不影响NF-kappaBα抑制剂（IkappaBalpha）的降解，但阻止了RelA核转位及其与ICAM-1启动子的结合。与此结果一致，其他三种查尔酮衍生物（4'-羟基查尔酮、异甘草素和黄腐酚）不影响IkappaBalpha的降解，但抑制了RelA核转位。豆蔻明在人乳腺癌MCF-7细胞和人纤维肉瘤HT-1080细胞中表现出相同的抑制特征。RelA的半胱氨酸38（C38）不是豆蔻明的主要靶点，因为豆蔻明抑制了RelA C38S突变体的核转位。计算机分子对接分析证实，豆蔻明未定位到足以与RelA C38发生共价结合的距离，并且豆蔻明与RelA在不同位点相互作用。这些相互作用位点的突变消除了TNF-alpha刺激下RelA的核转位。本研究结果表明，豆蔻明在TNF-alpha刺激下抑制了NF-kappaB信号通路中RelA的核转位及其DNA结合。
